detail.title: Sale detail
detail.costCoverage: Only {{percent}}% of the sale has a cost recorded: the real profit would be higher.

cancel.title: Delete sale
cancel.body: This {{total}} sale is deleted: it leaves the reports, returns the stock and cancels the credit it created. The sale is kept, marked as deleted, with who, when and why.
cancel.hint: At least {{min}} characters. It is recorded under your name.
cancel.reasonRequired: Write a reason of at least {{min}} characters to delete a paid sale.

return.title: Return items
return.body: Choose what the customer brings back and how much. The return counts on today's business day (the sale's day does not change) and the stock goes back to inventory.
return.reasonHint: Required, at least {{min}} letters. It is recorded with your name and the owner is notified.

error.RETURN_EXCEEDS_SOLD: You cannot return more than what is left to return on a line.
error.CREDIT_NOTE_EXCEEDS: The return is larger than what is still owed on that credit: choose another method.
error.NO_CREDIT_TO_REDUCE: This sale has no open credit to reduce: choose another method.
error.REASON_REQUIRED: Write a reason of at least {{min}} letters.
error.RETURN_NOT_ALLOWED: You are not allowed to return this sale.
error.SALE_NOT_COMPLETED: Only a paid sale can be returned.

queue.title: To charge at the register
queue.hint: Tickets sent to the register from a phone that nobody has charged yet. They are not sales until charged; they are charged in the app.
queue.empty: No tickets waiting at the register.

people.title: By person
people.chargedHelp: Who charged each sale at the register.
people.servedHelp: Who took the order or sent it to the register.
people.filterHint: Tap a person to filter the list; tap again to clear the filter.
